text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Deyaaaaaahhh!!!
Oooooooh...!?!!?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo runs and runs!
She seemed to stall for a moment, but kicks into a second burst of acceleration from there!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: What truly phenomenal tenacity! Is this the fruit of her summer local circuit campaign?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: We did it, Trainer!

I called out from the stands without thinking.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That run just now...
It was like a real turbo engine.

Maruzensky nodded
and began speaking happily.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, a 'turbo' is a system that forcibly pumps
a massive amount of air into the engine
to trigger an intense combustion.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
To super accelerate, you need tons of air.
So Turbo-chan...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
She took a deep breath through the corner,
using that inhaled air to fuel her next acceleration.
And what's more—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Turbo's main weakness—delayed acceleration, the so-called "turbo lag"—barely happened at all. The reason must be—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's 'cause my body was small, you see♪

A small build. For an Umamusume,
that is sometimes a weakness. However...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Because her body is small, oxygen circulates quickly throughout,
allowing for rapid acceleration...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It has the crisp, responsive feel of small twin
turbos. You just can't get that with a massive
single turbo lag monster.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I don't know how much of it was calculated, but
Turbo-chan's running right now is truly—"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That's "Twin Turbo's" way of running♪

It wasn't intentional.
Yet they say, 'names and natures do often agree.'

As a result of frantically striving to overcome her weaknesses,
it seemed Twin Turbo had arrived at a running style uniquely her own.
Delightedly returning to the waiting room—
Offer words of appreciation.
choice_data_list: Our path to autumn is clear now!
With this, the road ahead for autumn is wide open!

text_block_list.text: If you can pull off this kind of run, we can consider all sorts of schedule plans.
We could go for a Senior mixed medium-distance race, or maybe even the Kikuka Sho...

However, there was no reply.
Twin Turbo merely stood with her mouth agape.

Not just Twin Turbo. Nice Nature, who had
come to cheer her on, did the same...
just staring blankly at the TV screen.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Just now... on the news...
On the news...!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio... withdrew from
the Kikuka Sho...?
